notes: Environment tags are project-derived lab compatibility hints, not MITRE deployment-location assertions.
onprem means a self-managed host/application lab is relevant; it does not mean the technique is exclusive to on-premises infrastructure.
cloud denotes an explicitly cloud/service platform; cloud-hosted-endpoint denotes OS behavior on a cloud VM, not a cloud control-plane API.
Containers and identity platforms can span on-premises and cloud environments. Determine actual hosting per scenario.
A documented test is a simulation candidate, not a safety review, proof of full-technique coverage, or a runnable module integration.
No documented test in the pinned Atomic index means unsupported in this catalog's current evidence set, not impossible across all tools.
